task_completion.description: The agent successfully opens the 4HHB.pdb file in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface shows '4HHB' or 'hemoglobin_4HHB.pdb' in the Project View or as an active 3D/Sequence view.

task_completion.description: The agent exports chains A, B, C, and D as separate FASTA files to the results directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or UGENE export dialog showing chain_A.fasta, chain_B.fasta, chain_C.fasta, and chain_D.fasta in the ~/UGENE_Data/results/ folder.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a combined multi-FASTA file named all_chains.fasta.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of 'all_chains.fasta' in the results directory or a text editor showing a file containing multiple '>' headers.

task_completion.description: The agent performs a multiple sequence alignment using the MUSCLE algorithm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The MUSCLE alignment dialog in UGENE being configured or a progress bar for the MUSCLE task.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the alignment in ClustalW format to chains_alignment.aln.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog showing the format set to 'ClustalW' and the filename 'chains_alignment.aln' in the results directory.

task_completion.description: The agent writes a report identifying alpha/beta chains and their differences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing 'chain_analysis_report.txt' containing text about 4 chains, identifying A/C as alpha and B/D as beta, and noting sequence differences.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform the analysis rather than just using CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking menus, buttons, or dialogs within the UGENE application window.

integrity.description: The alignment was actually generated by the software, not pre-written.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Task Manager' or a specific alignment window showing the four sequences (A, B, C, D) aligned with gaps.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific paths requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: File paths in export dialogs or terminal commands show '~/UGENE_Data/results/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For 4HHB: Chains A and C are Alpha subunits (141 amino acids). Chains B and D are Beta subunits (146 amino acids). Alpha chains A and C are identical to each other. Beta chains B and D are identical to each other. The alignment should show significant differences between the Alpha and Beta groups (approx. 45% sequence identity). Expected files: chain_A.fasta, chain_B.fasta, chain_C.fasta, chain_D.fasta, all_chains.fasta, chains_alignment.aln, and chain_analysis_report.txt.
